mapper.sql: t.* , qc_task.task_no AS task_no , qc_result.item_name AS result_item_name , (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM mes_defect_file df WHERE df.defect_id = t.id AND df.deleted = 0) AS file_count
FROM mes_defect t LEFT JOIN mes_qc_task qc_task ON qc_task.id = t.task_id AND qc_task.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_qc_result qc_result ON qc_result.id = t.result_id AND qc_result.deleted = 0
